verdict.rationale: Poly ships an official `poly` CLI described as making files "searchable and scriptable from the terminal" (e.g. `poly search ...`), which supports headless scripted automation. Nothing documents CI usage or non-interactive authentication, and the hosted MCP path requires in-browser OAuth on first connection, which works against unattended CI runs. missing for 10: documented CI/headless mode, non-interactive auth (API keys/service tokens), CI examples or integrations, independent hands-on corroboration of scripted runs.
